column4: 道中、サテラにレキシントンの事を聞く
column5: On the way, ask Satella about Lexington.

column4: 知らないというか、居ないはずなんだけど
column5: She doesn't really know; he shouldn't even exist.

column4: 昔いたよ、聖魔教団との戦争において唯一人間に倒されたのが
column5: He was around long ago, the only one defeated by humans in the war against the Holy Magic Sect.

column4: 魔人レキシントン、魔人の恥と言われていた
column5: Fiend Lexington, called the disgrace of Fiends.

column4: 死んだと聞いていたのだけど・・
column5: I heard he was dead, though...

column4: もしかして復活したのかしら
column5: Could it be he has been resurrected?

column4: どんな奴なのだ、可愛いか？
column5: What kind of guy is he? Is he cute?

column4: おっさんだよ、鬼、ごっつい。見た事ないけどいう聞いている
column5: An old man, an Oni, tough-looking. I haven't seen him, just heard about him.

column4: \t\tレキシントンがケイブリス派に参加したのは最近で
column5: Lexington recently joined the Kayblis faction.
